description: Fetch a video's transcript as clean plain text. Resilient: tries InnerTube, then the timedtext caption track, then local yt-dlp if installed. Long transcripts are chunked — check totalChars and call again with offsetChars to continue.

offsetChars.description: Character offset to resume a chunked transcript

video.description: Video ID or any YouTube URL
